$schema: cross-language golden fixtures for deterministic Enchiridion PageID / blob-id derivation
note: Single source of truth for the plan's Critical invariant (deterministic PageIDs ported byte-for-byte, locked with cross-language golden tests). Loaded by packages/graph-core/src/index.test.ts on the TS side. The Swift side does NOT yet load this file — see apps/swift/Tests/GOLDEN_IDS_TODO.md in projects/enchiridion for why and what must happen before release.

digestScheme.idDigest: SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes, truncated to the first 20 bytes (160 bits), lowercase hex (40 chars). Swift: PageID.digest(_:), apps/enchiridion/Sources/EnchiridionCore/PageModels.swift:54-59.
digestScheme.fullDigest: SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes, full 32 bytes, lowercase hex (64 chars). Used for CalendarMaterializedIdentity.uidDigest/.sourceScopeDigest (CalendarEventMaterialization.swift:24,31-32,43-44) and for blob_ ids (fresh design choice, no Swift precedent — see deriveBlobId doc comment in src/index.ts).
digestScheme.separator: NUL byte (U+0000) joins multi-field digest inputs, e.g. Swift's `joined(separator: "\u{0}")`.

dailyPageIds.description: single-digit month and day via numeric components (zero-padding check)

personPageIds.description: mixed case with surrounding whitespace/newline (trim-then-lowercase normalization)
another already-normalized email, distinct digest from case 1

eventPageIds.description: timed materialized calendar event (occurrenceToken = "instant\0<epochSecondsTruncatedTowardZero>"), originalStartDate given as epoch milliseconds

blobIds.description: empty buffer — standard SHA-256 test vector for the empty string, independently verifiable
short ASCII string "hello world" — commonly cited SHA-256 test vector, independently verifiable

emailThreadPageIds.description: typical Gmail thread id (hex string, as Gmail's API returns it)
surrounding whitespace is trimmed before digesting (no lowercasing — Gmail thread ids are case-sensitive hex)
another thread id, distinct digest from case 1
